correction_scope: The only scientific acceptance-logic change is correction of the v0.3.1 wrapper's lineage-regression validator.

Execution-integrity hardening adds isolated-mode startup, exact-path authenticated module loading, a private read-only checkpoint snapshot, and durable one-shot artifact ownership; none changes scientific inputs or computations.
Preserve and authenticate every v0.3.1 frozen scientific byte.
Reuse the exact v0.3.1 checkpoints, serialized fresh episodes, deterministic word bank, scientific modules, numerical profile, gates, composites, and claim boundaries.
Write only V032-named run-start, invalid-attempt, and result artifacts.
interpretation: The authenticated v0.3.1 bootstrap read both checkpoint files as raw bytes to verify their SHA-256 digests. Its runner then validated lineage before creating the irreversible run-start ledger and before calling the restricted checkpoint deserializer. The validator incorrectly required maximum_merge_multiplicity at seed level even though the authenticated lineage record stores that field per episode. The v0.3.1 attempt therefore aborted before ledger creation, before checkpoint deserialization, and before fresh endpoint execution; it produced no learned scientific endpoint.
no_new_endpoint_inspection: No checkpoint is deserialized and no learned endpoint is evaluated while preparing or freezing v0.3.2. Raw checkpoint bytes are read only for frozen-byte SHA-256 authentication.
